subject: Post-demo: Stakeholder map & MAP \u0014 next steps for FinPay
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Jones <emily.jones@finpay.com>, Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@finpay.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Stakeholder map & MAP  next steps for FinPay

Hi Emily / Alex 

Thanks again for carving out time today  great conversation and really clear signals that FinPay is prioritizing latency/cost for your customer-facing credit product. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

What we covered:
- Redwood architecture fit: hosted API for POC, Dedicated for production throughput guarantees
- Key decision criteria you called out: 99th %-tile latency under 150ms, predictable per-token cost, SOC2 + contract language on data handling
- Stakeholders: Emily (product), Alex (security), Procurement (purchase/terms), and an economic buyer likely on the payments leadership team

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Stakeholder map: Can you confirm any additional names for security/legal/procurement? I've attached an initial stakeholder map and a draft MAP (mutual action plan) that breaks milestones and owners.
2) Procurement checklist: Alex / Procurement  can you confirm preferred contract cadence and any must-have contract terms (e.g. data retention, audit rights)?
3) Technical proof points: We will send a short latency/cost demo runbook and suggested test dataset by Friday (Jun 12).

Attachments: FinPay_MAP_v1.xlsx (draft MAP), FinPay_Stakeholder_Map.pdf

Proposed milestone timeline in the MAP:
- Week 1: Confirm stakeholders & procurement path (Emily / Procurement)
- Week 2: POC environment + sample run (Redwood + FinPay eng)
- Week 3: Security questionnaire and SOC2 evidence exchange
- Week 46: Pilot performance tuning + pricing discussion

If that looks good I'll update the MAP with any additional names you share and schedule a 30-min sync next week to align on procurement owners.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

--
Attachment stubs:
- FinPay_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 3 sheets: milestones, owners, open items)
- FinPay_Stakeholder_Map.pdf (one-page org map)

From: Emily Jones <emily.jones@finpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@finpay.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@finpay.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Stakeholder map & MAP  next steps for FinPay

Thanks Marissa  appreciate the clear summary. Quick clarifications: 

- Stakeholders: adding two names to the map  Sarah Patel (Head of Payments, she will be the economic buyer) and Luis Gomez (Platform Engineering lead)  I'll send direct intros after I loop in Sarah.
- Procurement: procurement@finpay.com is the right inbox for initial contract questions; they typically want a security addendum + standard data processing terms.
- Timeline: Week 1 sounds right; we prefer the POC to be in our dev environment with a non-prod dataset.

Would you mind moving the MAP timeline out by one week? Our internal approval cycle for the economic buyer is tight next week. Otherwise the milestones look good.

Emily
Director, Product  FinPay
emily.jones@finpay.com

Hi Emily / Sarah 

Thanks for adding Sarah  welcome. Per your note on shifting timelines, I've updated the attached MAP to move milestones out by one week and to call out owners more explicitly. Key changes in v1.1: 
- POC start moved to Week 2 (dev env, non-prod data)
- Security evidence milestone: we've listed the docs we can provide (SOC2 report, data flow diagrams, encryption-at-rest details)  tagging Alex for specifics
- Procurement step: we added a procurement checklist for your legal team to review (standard DPA language and SSO/KMS questions)

Camila  looping you in to coordinate the POC runbook and to confirm which Redwood engineers will be on the sync. Dylan, can you prepare a 30-min POC runbook (latency/cost baseline steps + test dataset spec)?

Emily / Procurement: Would you prefer a DocuSign for an MSA or a countersigned PDF for now? If you can share procurement contact details (name + preferred cadence) we'll include them on the MAP owners column.

Updated attachments: FinPay_MAP_v1.1.xlsx, FinPay_Stakeholder_Map_v1.pdf

Thanks  will follow up with a calendar invite for the POC kickoff once I have confirmation on owners.

Best,
Marissa

This looks good. A few quick notes from Security: 
- Please send SOC2 type II report and encryption-at-rest details to alex.mercer@finpay.com and procurement@finpay.com. We prefer a short control summary + attachments.
- For contract cadence: procurement prefers a countersigned PDF for POC, then MSA + DPA for pilot/prod  I'll share the procurement contact (Maya Chen) in a separate email to procurement@redwood.ai.

Camila / Dylan: happy to join the POC kickoff for the technical run-through.

Alex
